name: Daily issue triage
description: Each morning, report likely duplicate issues, proposed severity and security labels, stale issues and the items that need a human.

reviewBeforeSaving.note: Choose the repositories whose issues should be triaged. Without one the run has no issues to read.
Runs at 07:00 UTC on weekdays. Change the time or turn the schedule off to run it only on demand.
Starts as Dry run, so a run only writes the report. Raise it to Preview & approve or Auto only when you want an agent to act on the report, for example by creating TODOs or tasks.
